flags.usage: Walk forward through every page with cursors (starting after --after when given) and return all outlets in one data array, at most 10000 (the hard cap; then meta.page_info.has_next_page is true). A live traversal, not a snapshot: outlets created, changed or deleted during the walk may be missed or seen out of order.

flags.name: limit
flags.usage: Return at most this many outlets (1-10000), following cursors across pages as needed (a walk like --all; not with --page or --total). meta.page_info.has_next_page is true if more exist; resume with --after <next_cursor> when present.

flags.name: id
flags.usage: Filter by outlet UUID (repeatable).

flags.name: code
flags.usage: Filter by outlet code (repeatable).

flags.name: name
flags.usage: Filter by outlet name (partial match).

flags.name: search
flags.usage: Server-side free-text search.

flags.name: is-master
flags.usage: Filter by master outlet status; use --is-master=false for other outlets.

flags.name: sort
flags.usage: Field to sort by.

flags.name: order
flags.usage: Sort direction.

flags.name: with-organization
flags.usage: Include the outlet's organization.

flags.name: with-owner
flags.usage: Include the outlet's owner.

flags.name: fields
flags.usage: Comma-separated top-level fields to keep in each record (the data object, or each element of the data array); the envelope stays. Fields a record lacks stay absent. Names must come from record_fields in `gatherdeal commands`. Applied before --jq.

flags.name: jq
flags.usage: jq expression over data (not the envelope) of a successful result. Prints each result on its own line instead of the envelope: strings raw, other values as compact JSON. A failure prints the normal error envelope unfiltered. An invalid expression exits 2 before any request.

commands.name: outlets list
commands.summary: List outlets this access may read.

flags.name: profile
flags.usage: Local profile name (default: "default", the built-in production profile; with --server: the server host).

flags.name: server
flags.usage: Non-default GatherDeal server origin. Only pass it if you chose that server yourself.

flags.name: lang
flags.usage: Language of server error text: a tag such as ms, zh-Hans, zh-Hant or en, or an Accept-Language list (default: from LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG; otherwise en). Error codes never change.

flags.name: accept-server-risk
flags.usage: Confirm a non-default --server during auth login without a terminal prompt; ignored by other commands. Must equal the server origin exactly. Only pass it if you chose that server yourself.

flags.name: fields
flags.usage: Comma-separated top-level fields to keep in each record (the data object, or each element of the data array); the envelope stays. Fields a record lacks stay absent. Names must come from record_fields in `gatherdeal commands`. Applied before --jq.

flags.name: jq
flags.usage: jq expression over data (not the envelope) of a successful result. Prints each result on its own line instead of the envelope: strings raw, other values as compact JSON. A failure prints the normal error envelope unfiltered. An invalid expression exits 2 before any request.

commands.name: outlets get
commands.summary: Show one outlet this access may read, by id or code.

environment.name: GATHERDEAL_TOKEN
environment.purpose: A delegated-access token (gd_dat_…) for the built-in production profile. Never persisted; not combinable with --server or --profile.

environment.name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
environment.purpose: Base of the config directory (Linux/macOS); default ~/.config.

environment.name: APPDATA
environment.purpose: Base of the config directory on Windows.

environment.name: LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG
environment.purpose: Standard locale; the first one set chooses the language of server error text (en, ms, zh-Hans, zh-Hant) unless --lang is given.

environment.name: GATHERDEAL_LAUNCHER
environment.purpose: Set to "npm" by the npm launcher only; `update` reads it to confirm an npm install. Never set it yourself.

environment.name: LOCALAPPDATA
environment.purpose: Windows: locates the documented install directory (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\gatherdeal) for `update`.

exit_codes.meaning: Unclassified failure, protocol violation (including any HTTP redirect) or internal CLI failure.
exit_codes.name: unclassified

exit_codes.meaning: Invalid command, flag or input, including CLI_SKILL_PATH_INVALID (error.details.path is the absolute invalid skill path) and CLI_JQ_FAILED (a --jq expression failed on a successful result; data holds the unfiltered result, and the command, including any write, already succeeded).
exit_codes.name: usage

exit_codes.meaning: Authentication required, expired, unused for too long or revoked. Run `gatherdeal auth login`.
exit_codes.name: auth

exit_codes.meaning: Permission, scope or entitlement denied. Retrying does not help.
exit_codes.name: denied

exit_codes.meaning: Not found, or outside the outlets this access may read.
exit_codes.name: not_found

exit_codes.meaning: Conflict, failed precondition or other domain error, including CLI_SKILL_CONFLICT (error.details.paths lists conflicting files relative to error.details.dir).
exit_codes.name: conflict

exit_codes.meaning: Rate limited. retryable means the failure condition is transient, never that repeating a command that changes state is safe.
exit_codes.name: rate_limited

exit_codes.meaning: Network, TLS, DNS or timeout failure, or a server error (5xx). retryable means the failure condition is transient, never that repeating a command that changes state is safe.
exit_codes.name: unavailable

exit_codes.meaning: A human must act first (approve the login, accept a server risk, choose a credential store).
exit_codes.name: action_required
